SELECT REPLACE(v.vessel_id, 'vessel:', '') AS vessel_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(jc.charge), 0) AS total_established_charges
FROM vessel v
LEFT JOIN tow_job t ON t.vessel_id = REPLACE(v.vessel_id, 'vessel:', '')
LEFT JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
GROUP BY v.vessel_id
ORDER BY vessel_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: Only rows in job_charge count as established charges. Jobs J5, J6, and J7 have no job_charge row and were excluded from vessel totals rather than treated as zero charges.

SELECT job_id, vessel_id
FROM tow_job
WHERE berth = 'B12'
ORDER BY job_id;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jc.charge), 0) AS total_established_charges
FROM tow_job t
LEFT JOIN job_charge jc ON jc.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12';

SELECT t.job_id, bo.status, bo.reason
FROM tow_job t
JOIN billing_outcome bo ON bo.job_id = t.job_id
WHERE t.berth = 'B12' AND bo.status = 'insufficient_evidence'
ORDER BY t.job_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: Established charges come only from job_charge (none at B12). Jobs without established billing are identified via billing_outcome status insufficient_evidence; both B12 jobs lack job_charge rows and are listed separately, not counted as zero-dollar billings.
